Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla): SFG ≤ 2500 Gauss/cm (25 T/m); at 1.5 T: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg, No more than 30 minutes of active scan time per session, Followed by a wait time of 15 minutes; at 3 T: whole-body averaged SAR of 0.1 W/kg or less, Limit total active scanning to 10 min.
Image artifact: up to 5 mm.
